capabilities: Import a Diaro backup ZIP as dated Markdown notes with source properties
Preview entry, photo and conflict counts before importing
Copy referenced photos into an attachments folder and embed them in notes
Map Diaro folder, mood and tag records to custom property names
Compare a later backup and generate monthly review notes (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free core import, Pro features (saved presets, backup comparison, monthly reviews) require a GitHub Sponsors payment verified via GitHub device-flow sign-in. Settings open a What's new tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. Only XML version 2, unencrypted, non-ZIP64 backups up to 64 MiB are supported; phone, tablet, Linux and HEIC display are untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert a Diaro journal backup (DiaroBackup.xml inside a ZIP) into vault notes with their metadata and photos.

relations.evidence: Move a local Diaro journal into dated Markdown notes with tags, folders, moods, locations and photos.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Imports a Diaro backup ZIP as dated Markdown notes with tags, folders, moods, locations and photos, with a preview and conflict checks before writing.
